tei:div.tei:p: "$ (17)༄༅// zab lam nā ro chos drug gi gsal byed spyi chings khrid yig dang bcas pa

bzhugs so// karma pa rang byung rdo rjes mdzad pa'i chos drug gser zhun mar grags so// (18)༄༅// bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// rnam kun mchog ldan stong nyid mngon du mdzad// bde chen mchog ldan snying rjes srid pa 'dzin// zung 'jug mchog ldan rdo rje sems dpa' dang*// bla ma mchog la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// theg mchog snying po rnal 'byor bla med kyi// rdzogs rim mthar thug dpal ldan chos drug gi// snying po'i zhal gdams brgyud pa las 'ongs pa// gsal bar bya phyir re zhig 'di bshad do// 'dir sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa'i theg pa chen po rmad du byung ba la brten pa'i gdams pa dpag tu med kyang*/ tshe gcig lus gcig gis rdo rje 'chang chen po mngon du byed pa dpal ldan nā ro pa'i chos drug 'di la don rnam pa gnyis te/ shes par bya ba dang nyams su blang ba'o// dang po la bla ma'i brgyud tshul dang*/ gzhi lam 'bras bu'i rnam bzhag go /dang po ni yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang chen pos/ gsang ba pa'i bdag po la sogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams la de las rim par bka' bzhi brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la brgyud de/ klu (19)sgrub/ ār+ya de ba/ zla ba grags pa/ ma tang gi rnams ni lho'i brgyud pa'o// bir ba pa/ rdom bi yang zer/ bi na pa/ lwa ba pa/ in+d+rā bo dhi ste de rnams nub kyi brgyud pa'o// lū hi pa/ ḍeng gi pa/ dā ri ka /su kha dha ri ni byang gi brgyud pa'o// su kha ma hā sid+dhi/ thang lo pa/ shing lo pa/ karna ri rdo rje dril bu yang zer pa rnams shar gyi brgyud pa ste/ de rnams la dpal te lo pa chen pos gtugs pa'i tshul bstan/ dngos su bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'chang chen pos byin gyi rlabs shing lhan cig skyes mthar phyin pa des/ dpal nā ro pa la gsungs te gzhung las/ bla ma chen po nā ro pas/ bde mchog 'khor lo'i gsang sngags ni/

'bum phrag gcig tu bzlas pa yis// sa rnams g.yos shing lung bstan thob// ces so// de yang dka' ba bcu gnyis spyad/ bla ma mnyes pa sna tshogs kyis bsten cing*/ mthar phyag rgya chen po mngon du mdzad de/ bla ma'i bka' la brten nas 'phags pa thog med sku mched las brgyud pa la mkhas pa yin pas byang sgo srung ba'i paṇ+ḍi ta mdzad (20)de/ pu la ha rir bzhugs shing 'gro ba'i don mdzad de/ des mar pa/ mi la ras pa/ bla ma lha rje/ dus gsum mkhyen pa/ 'gro mgon ras la/ spom brag pa/ bla ma karma pa/ saṅgha la k+ṣi/ des rang byung rdo rje'o// bla ma rnams kyi rnam par thar pa ni gzhan du yod pas der blta'o// gnyis pa ni/ gzhi dngos po'i gnas lugs/ lam gyi rim pa/ 'bras bu skye ba'i rim pa'o// de yang gzhung las/ shar phyogs ngos su te lo pa'i// zhal sngar gdams ngag mnos pa ni// dngos po'i gnas lugs lam dang ni// 'bras bu skye ba'i rim pa'o// zhes pas/ dang po la gnyis/ gzhi dngos dang lam gyi gzhi dbang ngo*// dang po la theg pa chen po'i dbang du byas te/ lus dang sems gnyis las/ lus la yang rnam par phyi na gsum du 'gyur yang*/ 'dir phyogs gcig tu bstan par bya ste/ de yang dngos po'i gnas lugs ni/ lus ni byang chub rnam lnga dang*// rtsa dang byang chub sems dang ni// mi gtsang rdzas dang rnam rtog gis// lus kyi chos ni gnas pa yin// zhes 'byung bas/ spyir dri ma dang bcas pa'i sems kyis nye bar brtags shing zhen pa la brten nas snang ba yin yang*/ re zhig rten dang brten pa'i tshul du rnam par phye na/ 'gro ba rigs drug khams gsum pa rnams kyi/ rnam par shes pa'i gzung 'dzin gnyis las byung ba/ phyi snod dang nang lus dbyer med par rgyu dang 'bras bu rnam par phye ba dus kyi 'khor la sogs pa rgyud 'grel rnams las gsungs pa bdag gi blo la gsal mod kyi yi ges 'jigs pa'i phyir ma bshad do// 'dir 'dzam bu'i gling du skyes pa khams drug ldan pa'i mi lus la brten pa bstan te/

'di la yang lus 'grub pa'i rgyu rkyen/ ji ltar 'grub tshul bshad pa/ bshad pa'i dgos pa dang gsum (21)las/ dang po ni/ sems dri ma dang bcas pa 'dus byas shing las mngon par bsgrubs pas rgyu byas/ pha ma'i 'du 'phrod kyis rkyen byas shing*/ gsum 'tshogs pa las/ pha'i khu ba dang*/ pha ma'i khrag nad med pa dang*/ bar ma do'i rnam par shes pa la/ zla ba/ nyi ma/ sgra gcan/ zhes kyang btags te/ lus ngag yid gsum bskyed de/ dang po'i sangs rgyas kyi rgyud las/ sku ni thig le zla ba khu// gsung ni tshegs drag nyi ma khrag /thugs ni nā da thams cad 'byung*// zhes so// 'di la byang chub pa lngar yang 'gro ste/ dkar cha me long lta bu'i ye shes/ dmar cha mnyam pa nyid/ rnam shes rlung dang bcas pa so sor rtog pa thams cad 'dres pa bya ba grub pa/ lus rdzogs pa chos kyi dbyings kyi dbyings kyi ye shes te/ dgyes pa'i rdo rje las/ zla ba me long ye shes ldan// bdun gyi bdun pa mnyam nyid ldan// rang lha'i sa bon phyag mtshan ni// so sor rtog pa brjod par bya// thams cad gcig gyur nan tan nyid// rdzogs pas chos dbyings dag pa ste// mkhas pas cho gar gsungs pa yi// rnam pa lnga po bsgom pa nyid// ces sbyang gzhi sbyong byed sbyar te gsungs so// gzhan yang dang po pha ma gnyis kyi reg pa sra ba nyams su myong ba sa/ byang chub kyi sems gsher ba chu/ bskyod pas dro ba me/ g.yo ba rlung*/ bde ba nam mkha'i khams te/ dgyes pa rdo rje las/ bol+la kak+ko la sbyar bas// reg pa sra ba bag chags nyid// sra ba gti mug chos kyi phyir// gti mug rnam par snang mdzad brjod// gang phyir byang sems gsher ba nyid// gsher ba chu yi khams su 'gyur// chu ni mi bskyod gzugs kyi phyir// zhe sdang 'dren pa mi bskyod pa// gnyis kyis bskyod pa'i sbyor ba las// drod ni rtag tu skye bar 'gyur// 'dod chags (22)dpag med rdo rje yin// 'dod chags drod las 'byung bar 'gyur// kak+ko lar ni sems rgyu ba// de ni rlung ni rang bzhin can// phrag dog don yod grub pa yin// don yod rlung las 'byung ba nyid// bde ba'i 'dod chags khrag tu 'gyur// dga' ba nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de// nam mkha' ser sna rdo rjer 'gyur// ser sna nam mkha' las byung nyid// sems ni chen po gcig nyid la// lnga yi gzugs kyis rnam par bskor// zhes so// de ltar rnam par shes pa 'byung ba lnga ye shes kyi khams dang drug 'dus pa las lus 'grub par byed do// gnyis pa lus ji ltar 'grub tshul la gsum ste/

rtsa dang rlung dang thig le'o// dang po ni/ mngal gyi zhag bdun phrag dang po la/ nur nur po dang*/ gnyis pa la mer mer po dang*/ gsum pa la ltar ltar po dang*/ bzhi pa la gor gor po ste/ zhag nyer brgyad de/ lnga pa 'khrang 'gyur gyi zhag dang po la ma dang 'brel ba'i lte ba nas/ rang sor phyed dang bcu gsum gyi tshad kyi rtsa dbu ma chags la/ gnyis pa la snying gi dbus kyi rtsa bcu 'byung ste rtsa ba dang yan lag gi rlung bcu 'byung ba'i gnas so// de nas zhag re la rtsa nyis brgya nyis brgya 'byung ste/ mngal gyi zla ba brgyad dang phyi rol gyi bzhi ste bcu gnyis kyi bar rtsa 'phel bas stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis su 'gyur ro// rtsa 'di rnams kyi rags pa tsam bshad na/ zla ba zhag gcig / dang po la snying ga'i 'khor lo'o// gnyis par lte ba'i rtsa drug cu rtsa bzhi/ khyim bcu gnyis kyi dbye bas 'byung ngo*// de'i 'og tu mgrin pa'i bcu drug dpral ba spyi bo'i sum cu rtsa gnyis steng du gtsug tor gyi bzhi dang de rnams snying ga la 'phros te 'byung ngo*// 'og tu gsang ba'i rtsa sum cu rtsa gnyis dang stong pa drug gi rtsa lte ba nas thur du 'byung ngo*// 'di rnams ni 'khor lo'i rtsa rnams so// de'i (23)phyir spyi gtsug na rtsa bzhi dpral ba na bcu drug ste bad kan gyi rtsa dang*/ mgrin pa na sum cu rtsa gnyis/ snying kha nas brgyad dang rtsa bzhi bcu mkhris pa'i rtsa dang*/ lte ba'i drug cu rtsa bzhi gsang ba'i phyi rol du bskor ba'i rtsa bcu drug ste brgyad cu ni rlung gi rtsa'o// gsang ba'i nang rim nas 'dus pa'i rtsa bcu drug 'byung ngo*// de rnams la sogs pa nang gi rtsa drug stong chags pas nya lta bur 'byung ngo*// de nas zla ba gsum par rkang lag skye ste ru sbal lta bu'o// zla ba bzhi par tshigs rnams 'byung ba'i sar rtsa'i 'khor lo sum cu pa bcu gnyis 'byung ste/

de la sogs pa gzhan yang 'byung ngo*// zla ba lnga par sha dang khrag rus pa'i tshigs sum brgya drug cu 'byung ste ru sbal lta bu'o// dbang po rnams gsal bar byed cing*/ zla ba drug nas tshor ba 'byung ngo*// bdun pa la skra dang kha spu rnams 'grub bo// de'i tshe mngon par shes pa 'byung bar bshad do// brgyad pa dbang po rdzogs pas bkres skom 'byung ngo*// dgu pa'i mthar sdug bsngal zhing skyo ba skye bar byed do// 'di ni mi'i seng ge'i gnas skabs so// 'di rnams dus kyi 'khor lo'i nang gi le'ur/ lus 'di la ni khams kyi tshogs rnams ma lus ro drug rnams kyi bza' btung las ni 'byung bar 'gyur/ zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i tshigs su bcad pa bcus gsungs so// gnyis pa rlung la rtsa ba'i rlung lnga/ yan lag gi rlung lnga/ snar rgyu ba bshad pa'o// dang po ni rnam par shes pa dang nam mkha'i khams ye shes dang bcas pa/ rtsa dbu mar gnas pa/ thig le a dus me haṃ sgra gis bsten pa/ srog gi rlung ste dbus rlung ngo*// de la steng du 'gro zhes bshad do// thur sel ni/ a thung nas 'og tu 'gro zhing*/ dri chu dang khu ba 'byin sdom byed de/ sa'i khams kyi rang bzhin no// mnyam (24)gnas ni mdun gyi phyogs su rgyu ba snar ma'i rtsa las byung nas pho bar me mnyam du gyur te dngas snyigs lus thams cad du khyab par byed de 'di ni me'i rlung ngo*// gyen du rgyu ba ni/ shar lho mtshams nas byung zhing g.yas kyi phyogs nas glang po'i rtsar rgyu ste smra brjod kyi las byed cing gra ba'i gnas nas 'byung ba rlung gi rlung ngo*// khyab byed ni lho ste g.yas ro ma dang 'brel pa lus thams cad du khyab pa chu'i rlung ngo*// yan lag gi rlung*/ klu ni lho nub ste rgyal gyi rtsa las byung nas lus 'greng ba la sogs pa byed de nam mkha'o// ru sbal ni rgyab tu ste/ rgyal ba'i rtsa las byung nas rkang lag bskum pa la sogs pa byed de rlung gi rlung ngo*// rtsangs pa'i nub byang ste/

g.yon du nya bar byung nas khro ba la sogs pa skyed par byed de me'i rlung ngo*// lha sbyin g.yon nas byung nas/ rkyang mar 'brel cing glal ba la sogs pa byed de chu'i rlung ngo*// nor las rgyal ni byang shar ste shi ba'i lus la zhag gcig mi gtong bar byed de sa'i rlung ngo*// 'di ni snying kha'i 'khor lo ste/ rlung thams cad kyi 'byung ba'i rtsa ba mngal du zla ba gcig nas 'byung ste/ yan lag gi rlung 'di rnams rgyud gzhan nas rgyu bas mig gis gzugs mthong ba'i bdag rkyen byed/ rab tu rgyu bas sgra/ mngon par rgyu bas dri/ shin tu rgyu bas ro// yang dag par rgyu bas reg bya myong ba'i bdag rkyen byed ces kyang bshad do// snar rgyu ba ni lte ba'i 'khor lo las lus thams cad tu khyab par byed pa'i rtsa drug cu rtsa bzhi po rnams lnga tshan bcu gnyis bzhir gyur pa ro rkyang du 'brel cing rtsa gsum 'dus sar dbu mar 'brel nas srog gi cha dang bcas te g.yas pa'i cha la sa chu me rlung nam mkha' dang*/ g.yon nas nam mkha' rlung me chu dang sa'i rang bzhin du rgyu'o/ kha gcig la g.yas g.yon 'pho ba bcu gnyis/ 'pho ba re la dkyil 'khor (25)lnga lnga yod pas drug cu/ dkyil 'khor gcig la dbugs sum brgya drug cu yod kyang*/ bcu gcig dang bzhi cha dbu ma'i rlung yin pas 'di la ye shes kyi rlung zhes zer/ kha cig 'pho mtshams na rgyu zer te/ dbugs kyi so gnyis phyed dang bcas pa gcig gi cha shas yin/ de sna g.yon zla ba g.yas nyi ma skyed sdud kyi rim pas don la/ ye shes kyi rlung gi phyed nang du 'phel cing phyed phyir 'dor bar byed pas 'chi ltas la sogs pa 'char bar byed do// mdor na zhag gcig la rlung nyi khri chig stong drug brgya/ ye shes kyi rlung drug brgya bdun cu rtsa lnga ste/ phyi rol du lo gcig la zhag sum brgya drug cu chu tshod nyi khri gcig stong drug brgya 'ong yang*/

nyi zlas rgyu skar gyi dkyil 'khor mi 'khor bar rkang pa 'phel ba'i cha zhag drug dang zhag gi brgyad cha gcig gis rtsis thams cad rnam par dag 'gro ste/ 'gribs pa'i cha dang bcas pa/ 'jig rten pa'i snang ba la zhag bcu gcig dang bzhi cha lo gcig la lhag par snang bas zla ba sum cu so phyed dang gsum na zla lhag byung zhes 'dogs te phyi nang gcig pa'i rten 'brel yin no// 'di ltar phyi nang sbyar na gsal mod kyi/ rnam par spros pas chog go /rnal 'byor can rnams la gnad bcing ba ni 'og tu 'chad do// 'di rnams kyi nges pa'ang dus kyi 'khor lo las/ srog ni zla ba'i lam du son pa stobs byed bza' ba dang ni btung ba ma lus pa/ thur sel gyis ni thur du 'byin la ro rnams ma lus lus la khyer ba mnyam gnas kyis/ gyen du rgyu bas lus bskyed pa dang kha dang lag pa rkang pa rnams dang glu dang gar byed pa/ khyab byed nad rnams skyed par byed de rang gzhan yon tan dbang gis lus 'khyog pa yang de bzhin no// zhes pa la sogs pa tshigs su bcad pa bdun gyis gsungs so// gsum pa (26)thig le'i gnad ni/ thog mar dkar dmar gnyis las/ dwangs snyigs gnyis su 'gyur te/ spyi bo na dkar cha haṃ gi rang bzhin dang*/ lte ba na dmar cha a thung ngu'i rang bzhin ni dwangs ma ste dbu ma'i cha la brten pa lus can rnams 'chi ba'i tshe dkar ba 'og tu/ dmar ba gyen du 'pho bar byed cing rnam par shes pa'i rten byed pa ste/ dang po'i sangs rgyas las/ lus can rnams ni 'chi ba na// bdud rtsi zla ba thur du 'gro// steng du nyi rdul sgra gcan te// rnam shes srid pa'i mtshan nyid sbyor// zhes so// de las gzhan yang dkar dmar las dwangs snyigs su 'gyur te/ mngal du ni ma'i rtsa dang 'brel pas bskyed cing*/ btsas pa nas bza' btung rnams pho bar me mnyam gyi rlung dang drod kyis/ myag pa dang*/ mdog 'gyur ba dang*/

dwangs snyigs 'byed de/ sman gyi bstan bcos las/ ban kan myag byed/ mkhris pa mdog 'gyur/ rlung me mnyam zhes bshad do// dwangs ma ni mchin par khrag tu 'gyur/ de rtsa la brgyud nas sha de tshil/ de rus pa/ de rkang*/ de byang chub sems/ de stobs dang mdangs su 'gyur la/ de rnams kyi snyigs ma ni rim pa bzhin du/ dri chen dang dri chu dang*/ mkhris pa dang*/ pags pa dang*/ rme na bu dang*/ so sen dang*/ sbubs kyi dri ma mchil snabs la sogs pa dang*/ dga' ba'i mthar 'dzag pa ste/ lus zungs bdun zhes kyang bshad cing*/ rnam dbye ni saṃ bu ṭi las/ mi phyed pul+li ra ma nas/ so dang sen mo 'bab par gnas// spyi gtsug dzān+bh+ya ra ste// skra dang spu ni 'bab par gnas// u rgyan rna ba g.yas pa'i rtsa// pags pa dang ni rgyu ma 'bab// ltag par ar pu ta yin te// sha ni yang dag 'bab pa'i rtsa// go da ba ri rna ba g.yon// rgyus pa yang dag 'bab pa'i rtsa// smin dbus rā me shwa ra ste// rtag tu rus pa 'bab pa'o// (27)mig ni de wī ko ṭi ste// mchin pa 'bab pa'i rtsa gnas so// ma la wa ni dpung pa gnyis// snying 'bab pa yi rtsa gnas so// mchan khung kā ma rū pa ste// rtag tu mig ni 'bab pa'o// nu ma gnyis ni o tra te// rtag tu mkhris pa 'bab pa'i rtsa// tri sha ku ni lte ba ste// rtsa ni glo ba 'bab par gnas// sna rtse ko sa la yin te// rgyu ma'i phreng ba 'bab par gnas// kha ni ka ling ka yin te// rtag tu gnye ma 'bab par gnas// mgrin pa lam+pa ka yin te// rtag tu lte ba 'bab pa'i gnas// 'di rnams ni g.yon rkyang ma las gyes pa rnams so// de bzhin du ro ma nas byung ba ni// kanya tsi snying kha'i rtsa yin te// bshang ba 'bab pa'i rtsa gnas so// 'dom bar hi ma la ya ste// mtshogs ma'i mtshams ni 'bab pa'i rtsa// pre ta pu ri mtshan ma ste// bad kan 'bab pa'i rtsa yin no// gṛ ha de ba bshang lam ste// rtag tu rnag ni 'bab pa'o// brla gnyis sau raṣ+ṭ+ra ste// rtag tu khrag ni 'bab pa'o// byin pa gnyis ni gser gling gnas// rdul 'bab ba yi rtsa yin no// rkang pa'i sor mo nā ga ra// rtag tu tshil 'bab rtsar shes bya// rkang ba'i bol ni sin+dhu ste// mchil ma 'bab pa'i gzugs can ma// ma ru dhe sha mthe bong ste// rtag tu mchil ma 'bab pa gnas// ku lu ta ni pus mo ste// rtag tu sna chu 'bab pa'i gnas// zhes phyi rol tu gnas nyi shu rtsa bzhi/

nang du nyi shu rtsa bzhir khams nyi shu rtsa bzhi 'bab pa'o// de las gzhan ni/ 'dir ni lus kyi snying dbus su// rtsa lnga po ni yang dag gnas// zhes sngar bshad pa'i yan lag gi rlung rgyu ba'i rtsa rnams so// ro ma dang rkyang ma a ba dhū ti'i byed las kyang*// 'bum lnga las/ de ni thur du rtse gsum ste// de bzhin gyen du'ang rtse gsum mo// sgra gcan rtse mo dbus na gnas// nyi ma'i rtse mo g.yas pa'o// zla ba'i rtse mo g.yon (28)pa'o// chu dang me dang nam mkha' rgyu// g.yas g.yon dbu ma'i mar sna nas// bshang ba gci ba khu ba rgyu// zhes bshad pas rtsa gsum 'dus pa nas gyen du rlung rgyu la/ thur du dngas snyigs rgyu bar gsungs so// de ltar rtsa gsum bcas sum cu so gnyis te rnal 'byor ma rgyud las grags so// de'i steng du rtsa ba'i rlung lnga rgyu ba'i rtsa srog chen po ma gtogs pa bzhi bsnan na sum cu so drug ste/ thabs kyi rgyud las gsal bar bstan pas rigs sum cu so drug tu 'gyur ro// 'di rnams yi ge la sogs kyi sbyar bshad dang*/ phyi dang*/ lha la sbyar ba yod de/ 'dir ma bshad do// de ltar rtsa rlung thig le bshad pa'i dgos pa gsum ste/ 'dir sbyang gzhi sbyong byed shes par byed pa dang*/ rten bcings pas brten pa 'ching ba dang*/ 'bras bu'i don rtogs pa ste/ dang po ni/ lus ji lta bar phyi nang gzhan gsum ste/ 'dir bshad pa/ rtsa lnga rlung lnga 'byung ba lnga// phung po lnga dang sangs rgyas lnga// yan lag rlung lnga rtsa lnga dang*// khams lnga yum lnga rnam pa ste// dbang po lnga dang yul lnga dang*// dbang shes lnga ste bco lnga ni// byang chub sems dpa' lha mor grags// rnam shes ye shes drug pa'i khams// rdo rje 'chang du gsungs pa yin// bye brag rgyas bshad dpag med kyang*// 'dir ni rgyas par ma bstan no// gnyis pa ni rten rtsa bcings pas rlung 'ching*// rlung bcings pas thig le 'ching*/

thig le bcings pas rnam par rtog pa 'ching bar byed pas khyad par du 'phags so// gsum pa ni/ 'bras bu ni 'og tu 'chad do// de ltar lus kyi gnad bstan pas/ sems can skye ba sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku dang mtshungs par rtogs la/ gnas pa'i dus gnas skabs bzhi rdzogs pa longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur 'gyur zhing*/ 'chi ba chos kyi sku dang mtshungs par rtogs la// (29)yang na gnas skabs bzhi sku bzhir dag par 'gyur bas lus rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas su rtogs par 'gyur ro// 'di rnams kyang thabs dang shes rab kyi rang bzhin du gnas te/ gang phyir thabs ni 'byung ba nyid// 'jig pa shes rab srid mthar byed// ces he badz+ra las gsungs pa dang*/ gzhan yang bye brag rgyas bshad dus kyi 'khor lo las mang du gsungs pa 'dir ma bris kyang shes par 'gyur ro// mdo las/ 'di rnams gzugs kyi phung por bshad kyang 'dir rtsa lus kyi rang bzhin/ rlung ngag dang dus kyi rnam pa/ yid dwangs ma byang chub kyi sems dang 'gro ldog gcig tu bzhed pas/ ji ltar phyi rol de bzhin nang*// zhes gsungs pa bzhin rtogs par bya'o// de rnams sdud cing 'chi ba'i tshe rtsa chad pa dang rlung 'gag pa dang khams 'gyur ba'i tshul dus kyi 'khor lo'i nang gi le'u las mang du gsungs pa 'dir ma bris kyang da ltar mkho ba ni 'og nas bar do'i skabs su 'chad do// lus dngos po'i gnas lugs so// gnyis pa de la brten pa'i sems kyi gnas lugs ni/ sems phung po khams dang skye mched bag chags thams cad kyis bsgos pa/ kun gzhi zhes gsungs te/ de yang ngo bo rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa/ stong pa gsal ba/ 'gag pa med pa/ kun la khyab pa/ mi 'gyur ba/ rang ngo rang gis ma shes shing*/ yid kyis nga dang bdag tu rtog pas kha nang du bltas te 'dzin pas nyon yid zhes bya la/ yid 'du byed pas/ gzung ba dang 'dzin par shar ba/ der 'khrul pa'i rnam par shes pa las/

ming gzhi dang*/ gzugs su snang zhing*/ rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'i dbang gis khams gsum du snang ste/ gzung ba dang 'dzin pas 'khor bar snang ngo*// rgyas par kho bos phung po lnga'i don gsal (30)bar byed par bshad pa yin no// 'di ltar lus dang sems kyi gnas lugs rtogs na/ kun rdzob kyi bden pa mthong nas sdug bsngal dang kun 'byung ba bde blag tu rtogs par 'gyur ro// sems kyi gnas lugs 'di la brten nas/ log par rtog pa rtag chad du lta ba dang*/ nyan thos bye brag tu smra ba dang*/ mdo sde pa dang*/ theg pa chen po sems tsam pa dang*/ dbu ma pa'i 'dod pa rnams bshad du yod kyang 'dir ma bshad do// de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'dir kun rdzob sems kyi rnam par shes shing de nyid gcig dang du ma'i ngo bo dang bral ba nyid du rnal 'byor can gyis rtogs pas ye shes mthong bar 'gyur gyi log par rtog pa dang*/ 'jig tshogs dang mthar 'dzin pas ni nam du yang mi grol ba'i phyir ro// des na spros pa chog go /gnyis pa lam gyi gzhi dbang ni/ sngags kyi dgongs pas tshogs lam nas mthar thug gi lam gyi bar du gal che bar gsungs te/ de yang sbyang gzhi dang bstun nas/ lus sems 'grub par byed pa'i rim pas sngar

mngal gyi gnas skabs bstan pa rnams sta gon la sogs pa yin la/ skyes nas byis pa'i lus 'khrud pa ni chu dbang dang*/ gtsug phud 'jog pa dang rna ba 'big pa dag dar dpyangs cod phan dang*/ smra ba slob cing rdeg pa la sogs pas spyod pa/ dag par byed pa rdo rje dril bu dang*/ ming 'dogs pa ming gi dbang dang*/ rang gi rigs su ston cing bya ba ston pa rdo rje'i brtul zhugs dang*/ de'i chung ma sbyin pa gsang ba'i dbang dang*/ bde ba nyams su myong ba shes rab ye shes dang*/ 'chi ba'i gnas skabs la sogs pa sems med pa dbang bzhi pa ste/ 'di rnams dang rjes su mthun par sbyong ba 'jig rten gyi dbang bcu dang*/ 'jig rten las 'das pa phyag rgya chen po'i dbang ste/ 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa'i (31)'grel pa gsum dang rgyud rnams las mang du gsungs mod kyi/ dbang gi cho ga nas rgyas par bstan pa dang*/ yi ge mang gis dogs nas ma bris so// ngo bo ni ma smin pa smin par byed pa nyid yin pas thog mar dbang bskur ba thob pa gal che'o// rnam bshad ni thabs bzhi las bshad do// dbang thams cad lam gyi gzhi yin kyang*/ lam la 'jug par rtsom pas lam yin no// lam gyi rim pa la gnyis te/ bskyed pa'i rim pa dang rdzogs pa'i rim pa'o// dang po ni lus tha mal gyi 'dzin pa spong zhing 'jig rten gyi dngos grub bsgrub pa/ mngal skyes/ sgong skyes/ drod gsher skyes/ rdzus skyes sbyong ba'i don du gsungs pa rnams te/ 'dir yang mngon par rtogs pa'i rim pa ni/ gsang ba'i dbang gi dus dag tu// me long dri ma med pa la// rdo rje sems dpa' legs bris pa'i// de yi gzugs brnyan snang dang mtshungs// zhes bshad pas/ 'dir gang yang rung ba snang la rang bzhin med pa'i tshul du bsgom mo// rdzogs rim la'ang gnyis te/ mi zab pa'i rdzogs rim rtsa rlung thig le la brten pa dang*/ zab pa phyag rgya chen po'o// de la 'dir dang por gtso che ste/

'di la'ang spyir pha rgyud kyi gdams pa rnams rim pa lnga ste/ phyi dbyibs bskyed pa'i rim pa/ ngag dben rlung rdo rje'i bzlas pa/ sems la dmigs pa thig le dang phra mo'i rnal 'byor/ rmi lam ni zung 'jug gi rnal 'byor/ sgyu lus 'od gsal rnams so// ma rgyud thams cad phyag rgya bzhi ste/ phyi las kyi phyag rgya/ nang dam tshig gi phyag rgya gtum mo// snang ba chos kyi phyag rgya sgyu lus/ phyag rgya chen po ni 'od gsal dang lhan cig skyes sbyor/ rmi lam sgyu lus kyi yan lag /'pho ba dang bar do phyi ma'i mtshams sbyor te 'dir 'dus so// 'dir ni gtum mo dang sgyu lus/ (32)rmi lam dang 'od gsal/ bar do dang 'pho ba grong 'jug 'pho ba'i bye brag ste nā ro pa'i chos drug ces bya'o// 'di rnams rje ras chung pa ni 'dod chags bde chen du bsre ba gtum mo// zhe sdang bden med du bsre ba sgyu lus/ gti mug gi rtog par bsre pa 'od gsal/ gtum mo dang sgyu lus bsres la nyin par bsgom/ rmi lam dang 'od gsal bsres la mtshan mo bsgom/ bar do dang 'pho ba bsres la 'chi khar bsgom/ gang zag brtson 'grus can gtum mo// le lo can rmi lam/ tshe thung po 'pho ba dang bsre bas/ bsre 'pho dgu bskor zhes brjod do// 'dir bka' dpe las gsungs pa ni/ rtsa ba rnam pa bzhi/ yan lag gsum yod kyang*/ gnad bzhis ston te/ de la dmigs pa'i gnad ma gtogs pa gsum spyir bstan pa/ gzhung las/ de la gnad ni rnam gsum ste/ lus dang yul dang dus dang ngo// zhes pas dang po lus kyi gnad ni spyir/ lus bsam gtan gyi chos drug dang*/ seng ge'i nyal stabs dang gnyis 'dir gsungs kyang*/ dang po ni/ gzhung las/ de la lus kyi gnad bshad pa/ rin chen rtsar la brgyus pa 'dra// shin tu bsrang la dgug par bya// rgya mdud lta bu'i tshul du gnas// 'phel ka shin tu bskyed par bya// mnyam bzhag phyag rgya btsir bya zhing*// re mig tshul du bsnol bar bya// zhes pas rtsa 'ching ba dang*// rlung rang sor gnas pa dang*// drod dang bde ba skye ba dang*// rtog pa 'gog pa dang*/

rig pa gsal ba'i dgos pa yod pas lag len ltar bya'o// lus kyi gnad do// gnyis pa dus kyi gnad ni/ dus ring por bar do bzhi dang sbyor te/ gzhung las/ de la dus kyi gnad bshad pa// gnyid dang rmi lam snyoms 'jug dang*// tha mal dus dang rnam pa bzhi// zhes pas/ sems can thams cad la gnas skabs bzhi'i rtog pa las ma 'das te/ chags pa dang*/ (33)tha mal 'khrul pa'i snang ba dang*/ rmi lam gyi snang ba dang*/ gnyid 'thug por 'gyur ba dang bzhi'o// de la gtum mos 'dod chags dag par byed cing*/ tha mal gyi snang ba sgyu lus kyis sbyong la/ rmi lam ni rmi lam gyi gdams pas dag cing*/ tha mal gyi snang ba gnyid 'thug po la sogs sems med kyi gnas skabs lnga 'od gsal gyis dag par byed do// gsum pa yul gyi gnad ni/ gzhung las/ yul gyi gnad la rnam gnyis te// phyi nang gnyis su shes par bya// phyi yi snang ba dkar dmar dang*// nang du 'khor lo rnam pa bzhi// zhes pas phyi rol gyi snang ba gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos su snang ba ni sgyu lus kyi yul lo// nang du/ gtum mo 'khor lo gcig pa ni tha mal gyi snang ba bsdus nas lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lor sems 'ching ba'o// chags pa'i gnas skabs su 'bar 'dzag ste spyi bo'i 'khor lor 'ching bas yul du bshad do// rmi lam gyi dus su mgrin par 'ching ba'o// gnyid 'thug po'i dus su snying khar 'ching ste/ des na 'khor lo bzhi yul du bshad do// bzhi pa dmigs pa'i gnad ni/ re re la'ang ma zin pa zin par byed pa/ zin pa brtan par byed pa/ brtan pa bogs dbyung*/ rang bzhin gnyug mar 'jog pa bzhir bshad de lag len du bya'o// rgyud thams cad du 'byung ba zab mo'i bskyed rim/ mi zab pa'i rdzogs rim gyi mdor bstan pa'o// zab pa phyag rgya chen po ni/ gzhung las/ phyag rgya chen po'i man ngag ni// man ngag tshig bsdus dag pa shes// zhes pas thams cad kyi gnas lugs ston cing*/

de nyid du go bar bya'o// lam gyi rim pa'o// 'bras bu skye ba'i rim pa ni// gzhung las/ de la 'bras bu 'byung ba ni// lung dang man ngag nyams dang gsum// rim pas grangs kyis 'byung bar gsungs// zhes pas/ lung ni thog mar (34)sangs rgyas kyi bka' dang mi 'gal bar don spyi shes pa ni mnyan pa'i 'bras bu'o// man ngag ni zhi lhag gi don myur du rtogs pa'i go ba thob pa ste bsam pa'i 'bras bu'o// nyams rtogs ni bsgom pa'i 'bras bu ste/ 'di las 'jig rten pa dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i 'bras bu 'byung ste/ de'ang mdo sde rgyan las/ so so skye bo'i shes pa yis// de bzhin du ni gnyis rtogs nas// shes pa de yongs rdzogs bya'i phyir// mthun pa'i chos ni rab tu bsgrub// ces so// 'dir 'jig rten pa ni tshogs lam dang sbyor ba'i lam du 'bras bu 'jig rten pa yin pas mdo las tshogs lam chung ngu dang 'bring dang chen po'i rtags mang du gsungs kyang 'dir mi brjod do// sngags kyi dgongs pa ni/ skyes bu shes rab dang brtson 'grus ldan pas rdo rje theg pa thos pa tshogs lam gsum gang rung du 'dod do// kun spyod las/ dad pa yang dag bskyed pa dang*// rnal 'byor brtson la gnas pa ni// skye ba bye ba stong phrag tu// nga yi ye shes kyis bskul yin// zhes so// gang gis bskyed pa'i rim pas srid pa'i rtse mo'i bar gyi dngos grub thams cad 'grub pas/ de la brten pa'i las bzhi dang grub pa rnams ni tshogs sbyor gyi rtags 'jig rten par dri ma med pa'i 'od du bshad do// 'di lta bu'i rdzogs rim gyi rtags ni/ gang gis dang por bde ba dang gsal ba dang mi rtog pa gsum dang*/ du ba smig rgyu dang*/ me khyer dang*/ mkha' gsal te mtshan mo'i rtags bzhi dang*/ nyi ma dang*/ zla ba dang*/ sgra gcan mun nag dang dus me glog dang*/ nam mkha' stong pa dang*/ ye shes kyi bye brag thig le kha dog lnga pa ste nyin mo'i rtag drug dang bcu ste/

yang na 'bar ba dang bcu gcig kyang 'ong*/ 'di rnams dang por tshogs lam du 'gyur ro// de la brten nas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i don dang rjes su mthun par bsam (35)gtan gyi sems dang po dang gnyis pa dang gsum pa rim pas thob pa ni sbyor ba'i lam mo// 'dir yon tan brgyad de/ de la gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya dang lnga ni zla ba'i yon tan zhes bya/ rdul mun pa snying stobs te 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum ni nyi ma'i yon tan te brgyad po 'di ma dag pas 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal thams cad 'byung ngo*// de'ang bsgoms gzugs stong pa nyid/ stong pa nyid kyang gzugs su mthong bas gzugs bden pa dang*/ rtag pa dang*/ skye ba dang 'gags pa rang bzhin med par nyams su myong ba dang rtogs pa'o// de bzhin du stong pa'i sgra dang*/ dri stong pa dang*/ ro stong pa dang*/ reg bya stong pa nyid nyams su myong ba dang rtogs par 'gyur ro// 'dod chags stong pas khams gsum du chags pa'i sems ldog go /zhe sdang stong pa nyid pas khams gsum spangs nas zhi ba la dga' ba'i sems ldog go /gti mug stong pa nyid pas rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba go ba dang nyams su myong ba dang rtogs pas gti mug ldog te/ rgyu mtshan 'dis lha'i mig dang rna ba la sogs pa dang sngon gyi gnas dang 'chi 'pho ba dang*/ skye ba dang*/ gzhan gyi sems shes pa dang*/ gang du zag pa mthar dbyung ba'i cha rnams/ dang por go bas ni don spyi'i rnam pa shes so// nyams su myong bas ni cha dang mthun par nyams dang rmi lam du shes so// mthar rtogs pas ni ji lta bar mngon du 'byung ngo*// 'on kyang zag med ma yin te bsam gtan gyi cha shas las byung ba'o// 'di ltar na mdo dang khyad par ci yod/ ྂ 'on kyang bla ma rnams kyis 'di rnams la rlung gi yon tan tu mdzad pa ni/ sna g.yon zla ba g.yas nyi mar byas nas rlung lnga dang khams gcig tu mdzad cing*/

nyi zla nam mkha' gsum thig ler mdzad de/ sa'i rlung gi yon tan zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i (36)ming du mdzad pa ni 'gal ba ci zhig yod de/ de ltar log lta can rnams yon tan 'di dag shes par mi nus so// mdo sde rgyan las kyang*/ bsam gtan las thob mngon par shes// zhes bya ba la sogs pa rgya cher gsungs te spros pas chog go /mdor bsdus na rtsa rlung thig le sems gnad bcings nas tshogs lam chen po nas sbyor ba'i lam gyi 'bras bu 'grub par nges so// gang phrin las kyang*/ lta stangs rdzu 'phrul 'grub nas ni// mkhas pas sems can 'jug par bya// ces pa dang*/ zla drug sgom pa'i sbyor ba yis// 'grub 'gyur 'di la the tshom med// ces 'byung na su zhig the tshom 'gyur/ rnam rtog gi rlung brgya phrag bco brgyad dag cing thig le brtan par gyur nas/ gnyid dang rmi lam nyin mo bar 'tshams med par thams cad sgyu ma ltar rtogs shing*/ rnam kun mchog ldan gyi yon tan dang mthun par gyur pa na chos mchog tu 'gyur ba 'di la the tshom med de/ rgyud 'grel thams cad du gsungs pas so// 'jig rten pa'i 'bras bu mthar thug go /de nas gnyis pa 'jig rten las 'das pa ni nang du dbu ma la rtsa mdud rim gyis grol ba'i ming dang*/ rlung brgya phrag bco brgyad re dang*/ dga' ba re re dang*/ stong pa re re dang*/ snying rje re re dang*/ 'pho ba med pa'i thig le re re dang*/ rnam rtog las ye shes su gyur pa'i tshul gyis rab tu dga' ba nas chos kyi sprin gyi bar du 'grub par gsungs te/ 'dir yi ges 'jigs so// gang gi tshe rlung nyi khri chig stong drug brgya 'gags shing rtsa thams cad grol nas thig le rnam kun gyi mchog dang ldan pa nam mkha' dang mnyam pa ni/ rnam rtog brgyad khri bzhi stong ye shes zang mar gyur pa de la sangs rgyas su brjod do// de'i tshe sad pa'i tha mal gyi snang ba tshogs drug 'khor dang bcas pa ni bya ba grub pa dang so sor rtog (37)pa'i ye shes su gyur pas sprul pa'i sku'o// rmi lam gyi 'khrul pa srog gi rlung gis bskyod pa dag nas mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes su gyur pa ni longs spyod rdzogs pa'o// gnyid 'thug po la sogs pa sems med pa'i gnas skabs dag nas chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes ngo bo nyid kyi sku'o// chags pa'i gnas skabs dag nas bde ba chen po me long lta bu'i ye shes chos kyi sku ye shes kyi sku zhes kyang bya'o// 'di la mdo sde rgyan dang*/

rgyud bla'i gnas 'gyur rnams dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i 'grel pa skor gsum du gsungs pa sbyar na mang yang*/ spyi don go ba tsam byas pa yin/ gdams ngag chos drug gi go bar bya ba'i chings bstan pa'o// bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan du shog ༈ /chos drug gi sgom khrid bzhugs so// bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// chos drug gi gtum mo'i sgom khrid ni/ dang por stan bde ba la lus gnad ni/ rkang pa re mig ltar bsnol/ sgal pa bsrang*/ lag pa mnyam bzhag byas la/ dpung pa brgyang*/ mgrin pa dgug /lce ya rkan la sbyar/ mig sna rtser phab nas/ bla ma spyi bor bsgom/ ting nge 'dzin rgyud la skye ba'i gsol ba gdab/ rang lus yi dam du dran pa tsam byas la/ dang po lus kyi nang stong sang nge ba la dmigs pa ni stong pa sbyangs pa'o/ thun gcig ste zhag 'ga' bsgom/ /de nas rtsa sbyang ba ni/ lus kyi dbus dang po na yar dbu ma spyi bo tshangs bug nas gsang ba'i bar/ g.yas ro ma dang g.yon rkyang ma gnyis sna bug g.yas g.yon nas mar sna lte 'og sor bzhi tsam du dbu ma dang nang gcig tu gyur pa/ kha dog ni bshad pa la g.yas dkar po g.yon dkar po dbus sngon por bsgom zhes zer yang*/ gang rung gcig tu bsgom ste/ dkar ba/ drang ba/ stong pa/ gsal ba ste mtshan nyid bzhi ldan sems ma zin gyi bar du bsgom (38)pa'am zhag kha yar sbyangs te lta stangs dang bcas nas byed pa gal che'o/ thun gnyis pa'o/ /de nas rlung sbyang ba ni/ rngub/ dgang*/ gzhil/ mda' ltar 'phang ba ste bzhi ldan zhes pa/ dang po lan mang du bus/ nad dang sdig sgrib thams cad dag par bsam/ de nas dal la ring bar ran tshod cig rngubs ste/ steng rlung cha gsum mnan zhes pa lte bar non par bya/ dgang ba ni 'og rlung ril gyis 'then nas/ lto ba ther gyis byas la dbu ma la bzhag /gzhil ba rang lugs su glod la/ ba spu nas rlung rnams sibs sib song bar bsam/

mda' ltar 'phangs pa ni skabs su tshangs bug na yar sngo phyur phyur song bar bsam pa ste/ mang na 'pho ba dang 'dra bas mang du mi bya'o// de ltar sbyangs pas rlung yun ring du bkag kyang thang chad pa dang mi bde ba med par song na cung zad byang ba yin no/ thun gsum pa'o/ /de nas thig le la sbyong ba dang sbyar pa ni/ dang po smin phrag na rtsa gnas gru gsum pa phar tshangs bug dang 'brel pa bsgoms te/ der rlung sems kyi ngo bo thig le dkar la 'tsher/ snum la 'dril ba sran ma 'bring po tsam cig bsgom/ der gsal nas seng sgra dang bcas te tshangs bug tu song bar bsams la der bzung*/ yang dbu mar 'dril gsang ba'i rtsa ba'am rtse mo gang bder sems bzung la/ rlung dang bstun nas bsgoms pas dmigs pa gar gtad du zin pa dang*/ bde ba dang*/ mngon sum ltar snang ba'i bar du bsgom/ 'phro 'jog tsa na smin mtshams su bsdu'o// de rnams ni sbyong ba gsum zhes bya ste// ngo bo rnam rtog zin par byed pa yin// sems mi rtog par zin na rlung zin// des brag dros pas drod skye/ des bde ba skye/ bde la mi rtog pas bsam gtan skye ba yin no// dmigs pa la ni sems gtad nas// de rgyun rnam par g.yeng mi bya// ces pa la sogs pa mdo las (39)kyang gsungs te/ rtags du ba dang smig rgyu la sogs rnams ni mi 'dod kyang 'byung ngo*// zhal gdams kyi de rim pa bka' dpe bzhin yod pas lag len 'dir bris pa'o/

thun bzhi pa/ ma zin pa zin par byed pa'i gnad rdzogs so// zin pa brtan par byed pa ni/ lus gnad bca' sems bskyed/ bla ma bsgom ting nge 'dzin rgyud la skye ba'i gsol ba gdab/ lus lhar bsgom/ rtsa gsum 'dus mdor/ gtum mo a thung*/ ngo bo thig le/ rnam pa me/ kha dog dmar zhing reg bya tsha ba/ bde ba dang ldan par bsam/ de la sems zin pa dang*/ me khab tsam 'bar bar bsam/ de lam gsal na yar me sor gnyis pa bzhi pa tsam la sems bzung*/ des drod bde gsal mi rtog pa skye zhing 'di la brgyud pa gzhan dmigs pa bzhi byed rang re gcig byed de thun lnga'o sngar skyes na brtan par byed do// lung mang du gsungs kyang 'dir ma bris so// gsum pa brtan pa bogs 'byin pa dang 'brel pa/ dang po gong ltar bsgoms kyang drod tsam ma skyes na/ me cher bskyed pa bsgom ste/ a thung las me drag tu 'bar bas lte ba thams cad la khyab par dmigs la bsgom/ de brtan nas snying kha man chad mes khengs pa la dmigs la bsgom mo// de nas mgrin pa man chad lus thams cad tu gtum mo kha dog dmar/ reg bya tsha/ ngo bo bde/ rnam pa gsal ba la dmigs la bsgom de rnams zhag kha yar na spo ba'am/ dus gcig kyang rung ste/ lus kyi 'khrul 'khor dang*/ kha zas bzang du byas nas bsgoms 'di la 'brug skor rnams dmigs pa bzhi byed rang re gcig tu dril ba'o// so so ba yang rung ste khyad med do// pas drod skye'o/ thun drug go / rngul 'dzag na lus mi bskyod pas bkru/ me chung ngu bya'o// drod skyes kyang bde ba ma skyes na gtum mo 'khor lo gnyis (40)pa la brten pa bsgom ste/ lte ba'i a thung las me sor brgyad pa 'bar te spyi bo'i tshangs bug tu thig le'i rang bzhin haṃ dkar po mgo thur du bstan pa las thig le nyungs kar tsam gcig byung me la phog bde drod 'bar/ de nas haṃ la thig le'i rgyun rta rnga tsam bab cing bde stong du sems bzung*/

'di ni dam tshig gi phyag rgya ste/ don thig le dkar dmar 'dres pa las rgya'i bag chags sbyong ba'i don yin no/ thun bdun no/ /des kyang drod dang bde ba lus thams cad tu khyab pa ma skyes na/ gang drod ma skyes sar me dmigs drag tu bya/ lag mthil gyis mnye/ bde ba la/ spyi bo'i haṃ las/ hūm̐ dkar po gcig byung nor bu'i rtser bsgoms te 'og rlung 'then phul bya'o// des bde ba mi thub snyam byed na/ hūm̐ da spyi gtsug tu song bar bsams dmigs pa drag tu bya'o// de rnams kyis bde drod skyes kyang mi rtog pa ma skyes na/ rnam par rtog pa gang shar ba de la rig pas ngos bzung*/ dran pa yengs med du bzung*/ dmigs pa spos kyin bsgom// de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku'am shing bu'am/ rde'u la yang sems bzung*/ de rnams ni gtum mo'i dmigs pa dngos yin no/ bogs 'don la gsum mam lung byed na gcig kyang rung ngo*/ /da ni 'phros brjod de/ spyir dang po rtsa'i skabs su sems zin pa dang lta stangs gal che der zin na rlung la tshegs med/ bde drod rang bzhin gyis skye/ de la de tsam ma zin na me dmigs chung ba gal che'o// 'bar 'dzag sras na thig le'i gegs 'ong bas thun chung ngu bya/ spyir gsang sngags kyi gnad ni/ dug gsum lam du slong ba yin pas/ gtum mo la brten nas chags pa'i rtog pa sbyong ba yin pas rtsa rlung bsgoms na chags pa'i bde ba lta bu skye bas/ de rang bzhin bden med du stong pa'i gnad bcing ba gal che/ thig le'i gegs (41)sel yang dang po lus 'khrugs dus byas kyang mi phan phyis yun ring du bsgoms kyang byung na bya ba gal che'o// spyir bsam gtan dang po yan lag lnga las/ dmigs pa rnams thams cad rtog dpyod ste gnyen po yin/ rtse gcig pa bsam gtan gyi ngo bo yin/ dga' ba sems thog tu skye/ bde ba lus la skye ba yin/ de la ma chags par gong nas gong du bogs dbyung dgos/

dga' ba sems thog tu skye ba sgyu lus la brten nas 'ong ba phal che/ gsal ba'i bogs 'don kyang sgyu lus kho na yin/ bde ba 'di ngo ma shes na skyon che ste/ 'ga' zhig la bsgoms byas pas chags sems skyes 'dug snyams pa'i rtog pas sdug bsngal skye la/ la la'i gegs su song nas bud med la sogs par rtog pa 'phror yong bas/ yon tan tu shes pa la/ de la ma chags par stong pa'i rgyas gdab bya ba gal che'o// lar yang nyams bzang ngan gang skyes kyang rtog pa'i cho 'phrul yin pas ma chags par chu bo'i rgyun bzhin tu bsgom mo// gegs sel rnams ni gzhan du bshad pas 'dir ma bris so// rgyud rnams kun nas rab gsungs pa// gtum mo khrid kyi lag len rnams// zhal nas brgyud pa'i rim pa ni// rang byung rdo rjes bris pa yin// man ngag gnad kyi gtum mo ni// 'khor lo lnga ma de nyid yin// 'khrul 'khor drug pa zhes bya ba// sked pa g.yas 1bskor g.yon bskor gyis// lte ba'i rtsa mdud grol ba yin// ro stod g.yas 2g.yon bcud pa yis// snying kha'i rtsa mdud grol byed cing*// mgrin pa 3bskor zhing dgye dgu yis// spyi bo mgrin pa'i rtsa mdud 'grol// rkang 4lag 5brkyang bskum byas pa yis// tshigs kyi rtsa mdud grol ba yin// lus sprug 6phur bsub byas pa yis// rtsa rnams thams cad 'dul ba'o// skal ldan rnams kyis nyams su (42)long*// gtum mo'i dmar khrid rdzogs so/ ༈ /sgyu lus nyams su blang ba la gnad bzhi ste/ lus gnad gtum mo dang mthun/ yul snang ba dkar dmar ro// dus ni nyin par shas che/ dmigs pa la gsum las/ ma zin pa zin par byed pa sgyu ma spyir sbyang ba ste/ sngon du bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang gtum mo bsgom/ de nas dang po phyi rol gyi snang ba rnams sgyu ma'i dpe brgyad dang 'dra bar blta ste/ gzugs la sogs pa 'di rnams sems 'khrul par snang la/

phyi rol na med pa rmi lam dang sgyu ma lta bu rkyen las byung ba brag cha dang gzugs brnyan lta bu/ mi rtag pa zil pa'am chu bur lta bu/ snang la rang bzhin med pa smig rgyu'am 'ja' tshon lta bu ste/ de ltar sbyang zhing bsgoms pas snang ba la brten pa'i rtog pa yong ngo*/ rgyun gcig /de nas zin pa brtan par bya ba ni/ mdun du me long gcig shing khru gang tsam la dbyangs la/ lus kyi gzugs gsal bar byas la de la brdeg btsog dang*/ rgyan 'dogs pa dang*/ bstod smad byas kyang khyad par med pas/ rang gi lus kyang de dang 'dra bar blta/ ngag brag cha dang 'dra bar blta/ yid rtog pa'i smig rgyu tsam du bltas la bsgom/ de brtan nas nges shes skyes na/ dran rtog rang bzhin med par mthong*/ bstod smad khyad med pa 'byung ngo*// de bogs dbyung ba la gnyis/ de nyid la bogs dbyung ba dang*/ lha sku la sbyang ba'o// dang po ni nyams brtan nas gzhan gyis bstod smad byas pa'am byed du bcug pa'ang rung ste/ chags sdang skye'am blta/ mi skye na mang po 'du ba'i tshogs dus la sogs par phyin la/ de rnams kyi rkyen gyis gnod dam mi gnod pa lta/ yul la chags pa dang dga' mi dga' 'dug na/ dben par phyin la/ slar bla ma la gsol ba drag tu gdab/ skyo shas bskyed/ chags (43)'dzin gyi longs spyod spang*/ brtson 'grus bskyed la sngar ltar bsgom/ des lus ngag la zhen pa med pa dang*/ snang ba la chags sdang dang po dran pas bzlog nus na mthar ro mnyam par 'gyur ro/ 'di rnams kyang mgyogs khrid byed na gong la mthud/ /de nas sngags kyi thabs mkhas pa'i phrin las la gzhug pa'i don du lha sku la brten pa ni/ me long du rdo rje sems dpa'am yi dam gang rung gi gzugs 'char ba dper byas la/ lus gzugs brnyan lha sku sgyu ma lta bur bsgom/ ngag brag cha lta bu sngags sam theg pa chen po'i rang sgra brag cha ltar mos/ yid g.yo ba smig rgyu tsam 'di bde ba chen po rang grol du sbyang ste/

mdor na/ da lta tha mal gyi snang ba la/ yul phyi rol du bden rtog byung bas gzung bas bcings/ nang der 'dzin mkhan 'khrul par ma shes pas 'dzin rtog la bden zhen byung bas 'khor bar 'khyams pa yin/ de rnams bden med du sbyangs pas mdo las gsungs pa ltar gzung 'dzin spong ba yin la/ gsang sngags kyi lugs ltar de thabs mkhas pas snang la rang bzhin med par lha dang sngags bde ba chen por snang ba rnams su bsgyur la de yang bden rtog gis ma bcings par sbyong ba'o/ gsum pa/ /da ni 'phros bshad de/ ji ltar sgyu ma de bzhin du// yang dag ma yin kun rtog de dang 'dra bar brjod// sgyu ma'i snang ba rnam pa ji bzhin du// de bzhin du snang ba 'di gnyis su 'khrul par brjod// ji sgyu ma ltar de la de rta glang med pa// de bzhin du ni don bden med kyi rang bzhin dam nyid yin la // ji mod bzhin rta glang de ltar de ni dmigs pa ltar// de tshul bzhin du ni kun rdzob nyid// ces pas phung po lnga la sogs pa snang ba thams cad ni sgyu ma lta bu ste shes pa la snang gi bden par med pas rdzun pa ste des na kun rdzob ces bya'o// ji ltar sgyu ma dang rmi (44)lam 'khrul pa de med cing mi bden pa'i don mthong ba na ma 'khrul ba ste de ni don dam pa zhes bya'o// de sgyu ma med na ni de yi rgyu// gang yin de/ gsal bar dmigs pa ji lta bar// de bzhin du rtog pa'i gnas ni gzhan gyur na// yang dag pa dang ma yin pa'i rtog pa dmigs// zhes pas/ sgyu ma zhig tsam na shing bu la sogs pa 'khrul gzhi de mthong ba bzhin/ rang gi sems la gzung 'dzin gnyis su snang ba de mthong bas/ snang ba de la bden de shes so/ zhen log tsam nam 'khrul pa'i rang rig rang gsal ba de mthong ngo*// de lta bu ni de la yod// de sgyu ma yi dngos por bden pa yod pa ma yin// de ltar sgyu ma la sogs la// yod

tha snyad gnyis gang rung ste dang med pa nyid du brjod// ces pas/ des na sgyu ma'i rta glang 'khrul pa la snang bas med ces byar yang mi rung la/ rta glang der bden pa med pas yod par yang mi rung ngo*// 'on kyang snang bar yod do// bden par med do ces mkhas pa rnams gsung ngo*// de bzhin du kun rdzob la gnyis snang 'di la yod// de yi gnyis snang dngos por bden pa yod pa ma yin// de bzhin gzugs la sogs pa yang*// yod dang med pa nyid du brjod/ ces snang ba thams cad de dang 'dra bar gsungs te/ tshul 'dis shes kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang*/ chos thams cad kyang sgyu ma lta bu rmi lam lta bu/ zhes 'khrul pa la gnyis su tha snyad/ brjod kyi/ yang dag pa gnyis su med de zung 'jug gcig go /sgro 'dogs zung 'jug bstan pa'i don pa dang skur pa yi// mtha' rnams dgag par bya phyir dang*// theg pa zhi ba phyogs gcig dman pas 'gro ba dag /dgag par bya phyir 'dod pa yin// rgyu mtshan 'dis sgyu lus kyi gdams pa gal che bar shes so// (45)sgyu ma dang po snang ba sgyu mar bslab pa'i thabs rdzogs so/ ༈ /rmi lam nyams su len pa la bzhi ste/ lus dang*/ yul dang*/ dus dang*/ dmigs pa'i gnad do// thams cad kyi sngon du nyin par gtum mo dang sgyu lus bsgoms pa'i rjes la/ yang bla ma mdun gyi nam mkhar bsgom la/ rmi lam zin par mdzad du gsol zhes gsol ba gdab/ lus gnad seng ge'i nyal stabs te mgo byang du bstan/ ngos g.yas pa 'og tu gzhug /dus gnad gnyid kyi dus so// yul gnad mgrin par/ dmigs pa ni bzung sbyang ya nga ba spang sgyu mar bslab pa la bzhi las/ dang po la'ang*/ bdun pa thig le yi ge gsum las/ dang po ni mgrin par pad+ma 'dab bzhi bsam pa'i dbus su shes pa gtad de/ do nod rmi lam rmi bar bya'o// ngo shes par bya'o snyam du lan mang du bya/ des rmi lam du shes na chog /gal te ma shes na/

mgrin pa'i pad+ma'i dbus der thig le dkar po'am dmar po ril ma tsam me long ngam shel ltar gsal ba gcig bsgom la snang ba 'di rmi lam du shes par bya snyam pa yang yang 'dun pa bya/ des rmi lam du skrag sngangs 'byung ste/ des zin pa'i rkyen byed pa yin no// des kyang ma zin na/ mgrin par thig le'i sa der oṃ dkar po bsams la sngar ltar bsgom/ de bzhin du mdun gyi 'dab ma la a sngon po/ g.yas su nu ser po/ rgyab tu ta dmar po/ g.yon du ra ljang khu la rim pas bsgom pa'am/ dus gcig tu bsgom kyang rung ste/ 'dun pa bya ba dang bla ma la gsol ba gdab pa dang rnam rtog gzhan gyis bar ma chod pa gal che'o// thun gnyis sam mang yang nyan/ des rmi lam zin par 'gyur ro// gnyis pa sbyang ba ni/ bsgyur ba dang*/ spel ba gnyis las/ dang (46)po ni/ rmi lam bzung ba'i 'dun pa'i steng du/ do nod rmi lam du shes pas mi phan rang yi dam du bsgyur dgos bsam pa bya/ des bsgyur na rab yin/ gal te ma nus na nyin par de ltar du bsgyur la bsgom/ yang nyal khar rmi lam du bsgyur ba dang nyin par bsgom pa la khyad med do// do nod cis kyang bsgyur bar bya snyam du byas 'di la yang thun nges pa med/ mang po yang rung*/ spel sbyang dang bsgyur sbyang gnyis byas kyang nyan pas 'grub pa yin/ de bzhin du grub tsam na rdo rje gdan du 'gro ba dang*/ u rgyan dang*/ lha yul dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing du 'gro ba la sngar dang khyad med de/ 'dun pas chog go /gang du bsgyur yang nyin par gyi 'dun pa dang brtson 'grus gal che bas de ltar sbyang ngo*// spel ba ni rmi lam du rang lhar bsgyur nus tsam na/ de las gnyis dang gsum dang mang po spel la bsgom/ de bzhin du rmi lam du snang ba mi la sogs pa gang mthong ba de lhar bsgyur bar bya'o// de goms nas/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing la slob na/ dang po zhing 'di nyin par rnam par snang mdzad kyi zhing stug po bkod pa'i rgyan dang bcas pa rang gzhan thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad byang chub sems dpa' dang bcas par bsgom/

nyal khar mgrin pa'i dbus kyi oṃ la sems gtad la do nod ni rnam par snang mdzad kyi zhing blta bar bya'o snyam pa bya// des ma zin par rmi lam dang mtshan pa byung nas/ ngo shes na rmi lam rang du bsgyur bas chog /ma shes na chos thams cad sems kyi cho 'phrul yin pa la de ltar ma shes pa re ma legs snyam pa byas la drag tu bsgom/ de bzhin du 'dra ste/ mngon dga' sbyong na a sngon pa la dmigs pa ltar bsgom/ nu ser pos lho rin po che yod pa dang*/ ta dmar pos bde ba can dang*/ ra ljang gus (47)las rab grub pa'i zhing khams spyod lugs khyad med nyin gyi dmigs pa bas chog go /sbyang ba'o// thun gcig gsum pa ya nga spang ba ni/ rmi lam du me dang chu chen po dang*/ ngam grog dang*/ rlung 'tshub/ sha za srin po dang*/ khyi dang dgra la sogs pa byung nas/ de la skrag cing sbyong ba'i gegs byed na dang por rmi lam gyi sems su chig chus su khyer snyam du byas la bsre'o// gzhan yang rang gi mgrin par yi ge rnams bsgom pa dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi cho 'phrul yin na de la su 'jigs snyam du bya'o// des kyang ma sel nam gnyid pa'i dus su/ rang lus mes

gtum mos bsregs la mer bsgom pa dang*/ chur bsgom pa dang*/ rlung nang du rngub pas phyi'i 'tshub ma zhi ba dang*/ rnam shes hūm̐ du byas pa dhū ti dang nam mkha' la 'phangs pa byas kyin bsgom pas yang ba sel lo// zin khar sad pa dang*/ 'khrul pa dang*/ brjed pa rnams la dang po nas 'dun pas ma sad par bya snyam pa dang*/ ma 'khrul bar bya snyam pa dang*/ ma brjed par bya snyam pa yang yang bya des chog go /bzhi pa bogs dbyung zhing rmi lam de kho na dang bsre ba ni/ ci byas kyang ma zin na/ sngon du tshogs bsag /'jig rten gyi zhen pa spang*/ bla ma la gsol ba drag tu gdab/ nyin bar gyi snang ba thams cad rmi lam dngos su blta/ des mi zin kha med pa yin no// sbyang ba dang de dang 'dra ste/ gtum mo dang sgyu lus lha sku dang sbyar ba de la brtson pa gal che'o// des zin nas de kho na ni/ rmi lam na chos bshad kyang*/ rang dang gzhan dang sgra tshig kyang med de 'khrul pa la snang bar zad/ ces bden med phyag rgya chen po zung 'jug tu khyer la nyin par gyi sgyu lus dang 'dre'am bltas la bsgom par bya'o// (48)'di 'od gsal gyi sngon 'gro yang yin no// da ni 'phros bshad de/ rmi lam bsgom pa ni/ bar do'i sngon du 'gro bar gsungs pas/ rmi lam gyi ngo bo kun gzhi'i steng nas yid gcig pu langs te/ srog rlung dang lhan cig lus kyi nang du de ltar sna tshogs snang ba ste/ lus las shes pa phyir bud pa yang med/ yul bden pa nang du 'ongs pa yang med mod kyi/ sgyu lus kyang de kho na dang 'dra bar blta'o// 'o na yul snang ba'i rgyu gang zhe na/ las sna tshogs kyi bag chags kun gzhi la gnas pa de'i gzugs brnyan de la der 'dzin gyis nye bar rtog pa na/ de ltar yid la ut+pal byed pa na sngon po dang*/ lo ma la sogs pa 'char te/ 'di ni ut+pa la'o zhes zhen par byed cing*/ shes pa las gzhan der mi dmigs pa de dang 'dra ba nyid do// des na da lta yang bag chags brtas pas tshogs drug tu rags par snang yang*/

don la rmi lam dang 'dra ba yin no// bar do ni de las khyad med kyang*/ de nyid kyi skabs su brjod par bya'o// des na chos thams cad rmi lam dang 'dra ba nyid pas/ kun rdzob de ltar shes nas spel sbyang goms pas/ bar do dang da lta yang rdzu 'phrul la sogs 'grub par byed pa'i phyir yin gyi rmi lam du sprul bsgyur nus pa tsam gyis nga rgyal mi bya'o// pha rol tu phyin pa nas/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa nyin par bsgoms pas rnam par 'phel na/ rmi lam du bsgoms pas kyang 'phel bar 'gyur ro zhes gsungs so// chos kun rmi lam lta bu ste// gzung du med cing brjod du med// rgyu dang las las kun tu byung*// nyon mongs rgyu dang las rnams kun// tshul bzhin ma yin yid la gnas// tshul bzhin ma yin yid byed ni// sems kyi dag pa la rab gnas// dag pa gang la'ang gnas min pa// rtogs par bya phyir rgyal ba rnams// chos kun (49)rmi lam sgyu 'dra ston// de ltar rtogs shing dbang sgyur ba// gnyid dang rmi lam chags pa dang*// tha mal 'khrul pa zad las 'byung*// des na skyes bu dam pa rnams// zhen med rmi lam sgyu ma sbyangs// zung 'jug mngon du gyur par mdzod// rmi lam gyi gdams pa rdzogs so// ༈ //'od gsal gyi gnad ni/ lus gnad rmi lam dang mthun/ dus gnyid dang nyin par gnyis ka'o// yul snying kha chos kyi 'khor lor// dmigs pa ni ma zin pa zin pa/ zin pa brtan pa/ bogs dbyung ba'o// dang po ni gtum mo dang sgyu lus rmi lam zin pa'i skyes bus/ gnas dben par bla ma la gsol ba gdab/ mkha' 'gro la la gtor ma btang*/ 'od gsal ba zin par bya'o// snyam pa'i 'dun pa btang*/ rang gi snying pad ma 'dab ma bzhi par bsgoms pa'i dbus su/ hūm̐ sngon po/ mdun du a/ g.yas su nu/ rgyab tu ta/ g.yon du ra bsam/ 'di ltar snang ba thams cad sems kyi cho 'phrul snang la rang bzhin med par 'dug snyam du yang yang bsgom/

des zin kyang srid/ gnyis pa ni/ de nas nub mo'i gnyid 'od gsal du gzhug pa ni/ nyal khar snying kha'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ brtan g.yo snod bcud thams cad lus la bsdu/ de yang hūm̐ la bsdu/ de yang 'od kyi rnam pa'i thig le sran ma thun gcig tsam du bsams la gnyid log pas/ da lta'i snang ba nub rmi lam gyi snang ba ma shar ba'i bar der/ gsal la rtog med gnyid 'thug po rang yang ma yin pa bum nang gi mar me lta bu 'byung*/ de ngo shes par bya/ grogs la sogs pas bslangs la zin nam lta/ zin na bde stong dang gsal stong 'dres pa 'byung ba yin no/ thun gnyis/ nyin par sgom pa ni/ lus gnad gtum mo lta bu'am gang bde byas/ (50)lta stangs smin mtshams kyi mdzod spu'am nam mkhar gtad la/ rnam par mi rtog pa bsgom/ de la mi gnas na/ nam mkhar hūm̐ bsgom de las 'od 'phros thams cad bsdus la gsal stong du bzhag /rtog pa thams cad ngo shes par byas la gsal stong du bsdus kyin bsgom/ des nyin par dang mtshan mo thams cad gsal stong dang bde stong du 'dre bar bstan pa yin no// bogs 'di thun gcig gam yang na logs su bya dbyung ba ni rmi lam gyi snang bas skyed na sngar rmi lam zin pas rmi lam du shes pa'i tshe/ rmi lam de nyid tu sngar ltar bsgoms pas/ gsal la rtog med du zin par 'gyur/ des kyang ma zin na/ smin mtshams su rus pa gru/ gsum gyi nang du thig le sngon po snang la rang bzhin med pa la sems bzung ba'am/ yang na snying gar 'od kyi ga'u 'od lnga dang ldan pa bsams la gnyid ces gsung ngo*// des rnam rtog thams cad gsal yang stong par 'char ba'am bde stong 'dres pa 'byung ngo*/ gsum pa'am lnga'o/ /da ni 'phros brjod de/ slob dpon chen po lwa ba pas/ lo ni bcu gnyis bar dag tu// 'od gsal ba la gnyid log pas// phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub thob// ces 'byung ba dang*/ dgyes rdor las/

gnyid ni spang bar mi bya ste// dbang po rnams ni mi dgag go /ces pas/ spyir 'od gsal gyi go ba ni/ gnyid 'thug po la sogs rtog pa kun gzhi'i steng du song ba de rang dang 'dra yang*/ de la ma rig pa dang lhan cig yin pas gol sar 'gyur la/ 'dir dran pas dbang bsgyur nas gzugs sgra la sogs kyi rnam pa lam me 'dug kyang*/ rtog dpyod kyis ma bslad pa/ rtog pa mi 'gyur yang rnam pa thams cad shel sgong lag mthil du bzhag pa lta bu gcig 'byung ste/ de lam du 'gro ba yon te/ gnyid dang rmi lam mtshams shed na/ gti mug chos (51)sku'i ngo bo can// zhes pa dang*/ gzhi'i 'od gsal bar dor 'byung ba la khyad med ngo shes kyis dran pas zin na lam gyi 'od gsal yin/ me long ye shes su lta bur gyur pa 'bras bu'i 'od gsal du nges so// rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis zin cing*/ bsam gtan bzhi pa dang 'brel pa// de tshe me long dag pa'i dper// rnam pa kun snang rtog pa med// lam gyi 'od gsal zhes kyang bya// mnyam rjes med cing der 'dzin bral// ji lta ji snyed mnyam pa nyid// nam mkha' ltar gyur bde gshegs thugs// 'bras bu'i 'od gsal rtogs par mdzod/ 'od gsal pa rdzogs so// ༈ //bar do lam du 'khyer ba la gnyis te/ nyams len dang*/ go bar bya ba'o// dang po ni gzhung las 'byung ba ltar 'chi ba'i rtags rdzogs nas/ nyams su blang ba la gsum/ rab bar do 'od gsal ngos bzung*/ 'bring sgyu lus la rtsal sbyang*/ tha ma mngal gyi sgo dgag cing gdams pa'o// dang po ni 'og nas bshad pa ltar 'chi khar/ sngar 'od gsal nyin mtshan 'brel pa yod na/ de nyid la ngan pa gtad nas gzhi'i 'od gsal shes par bya'o// snyam pa'i dran pas zin par bya/ rtags rnams rdzogs pa'i rjes la 'di'i snang ba nub/ bar do'i snang ba ma shar ba'i bar der/ 'od gsal 'char te/ de la ji ltar sdod pa'i dbang yod pas// 'od gsal ba la rgyun bar gnas// bar do'i grong khyer de la med// ces bshad pa yin/

de'i ngang las zung 'jug gi lus su langs nas sems can gyi don byed pa ni/ theg chen gyi khyad par yin la/ khams gsum spang bya'i rtog pa thams cad bcad nas de nyid du zhi ba ni bar dor dgra bcom thob pa de dang dgongs pa gcig par 'dug /snying rjes zung 'jug gi skur langs la 'gro (52)don bya ba ni khyad par gyi gdams pa yin/ de ltar 'od gsal la brten na bar do dang po'i snang ba shar kyang de nyid du 'od gsal bsgoms pa ltar sbyangs na/ dag pa'i bar do mngon du 'gyur ba yin// bar do gnyis pa ni/ da ltar rmi lam sgyu lus 'byongs pa gcig gis zin te/ 'chi khar bar do la bar dor ngo shes pa byas la sgyu ma lta bur sbyangs te bsgom dgos snyam pa bya ba gal che/ de nas bar do'i snang ba shar ba'i tshe/ bar dor shes pa dang*/ chos thams cad sgyu ma lta bu'i nges shes bskyed la rmi lam gyi bsgyur sbyang spel sbyang ltar bsgoms pas/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing dang dga' ldan la sogs par 'gro ba la tshegs med pa yin no// bar do gsum pa ni/ da ltar gong gi yon tan de rnams med kyang*/ tshul khrims rnam par dag pa'am/ bla ma la sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes thob pa'am/ gtum mo'i drod bde gsal tsam zin pa'am/ bskyed rim cung zad brtan pa zhig gis 'grub pas/ 'chi kha'i mtshams sbyor ni 'pho ba la sogs pa gal che ste/ bar do'i dang po srid pa der 'byung bas so// dngos gzhi ni/ bar dor zhag phyed dang bzhi phan chad sngar gyi rtog pa dang 'bres la/ de phyin chad phyi ma kho na'i snang ba 'byung zhes pas gang ltar yang bar do des gang du skye ba shes shing*/ khyad par du pho ru skyes na mo la chags pa dang*/ mo ru skye na pho la chags pa 'byung bas/ skabs 'dir gong gi nyams myong dran nas sngon yang 'di 'dras 'khor bar 'khyams te da ni 'di'i dbang du ma song bar bya snyam pas chags sdang gi rtog pa bzlog nus tsam na mngal 'gag

/de nas bar do de nyid du sngar gyi nyams len sbyang zhes gsungs te/ 'di la gzhung nas/ phyi ma'i pha ma bar dor mthong tsam na/ bla ma la sngar mos pa thob (53)na bla ma yab yum gyis bdag la dbang bskur ba yin bsam pa bya/ lus ngag yid gsum bla ma la 'bul/ chags sdang gi sems dgag go gsung*/ bskyed rim brtan pas/ lam de yi dam yab yum du bsgom gsung ngo*// de ni 'jug yul dgag pa yin no// 'jug mkhan dgag pa ni/ rang sems hūm̐ du bsgom pa dang*/ lhar bsgom pa dang*/ gtum mo lta bu'i nyams myong la gtad pa dang*/ tshul khrims kyi gnyen po bskyed pa kho na'o// 'di rnams ni gnad gsum dang ldan dgos te/ 'chi khar sngar gyi nyams myong gsal ba/ bar dor ngo shes dus su 'dun pa drag pa/ gdams pa da ltar la lor ma bzhag par shin tu byang ba zhig dgos pa yin no// 'di dang ldan na 'chi ba nyid lam gyi grogs su 'gro bas mtshams sbyor rnam par dag go /yan lag dang phyi ma dang mtshams sbyar ba'o// da ni go bar bya ba'i 'phros brjod de/ bka' dpe las/ lus can rnams ni 'chi ba na// snang ba thim dang rtog pa thim// phra ba thim dang rags pa thim// thim pa'i rjes la goms pa yis// rang bzhin gyis ni 'od gsal 'char// zhes 'byung ba ni/ da ltar mi'i 'gro ba phal gyi 'byung lugs te/ snang ba thim pa ni/ gzugs thim pas mig mi gsal/ sgra thim nas rna bas gzhan gyi sgra mi thos/ dri thim nas sna bal gyis bkag pa bzhin 'gro/ ro thim nas lces zas kyi ro mi myong*/ reg bya thim nas lus kyi reg pa brtul du 'gro/ chos thim nas 'khor ba'i chos mi gsal du 'gro'o// rags pa thim pas/ sa chu la thim pas lus kyis zungs mi thub/ chu me la thim pas kha sna'i chu phyir byung nas skam/ me rlung la thim nas drod mtha' nas yal te/ ngan song du 'gro na drod ra ra 'chad/ mtho ris su 'gro na drod yar 'chad gsungs te/

ci rigs su (54)'gyur/ rlung rnam par shes pa la thim pas phyi dbugs chad/ nang dbugs cung zad mi 'chad de/ phra ba dang rtog pa thim lugs ni/ snang ba thim pa'i tshe/ thog mar phyi rtags snang ba sngar dang mi 'dra bar mthong ba dang*/ nang rtags shes du ba ltar ban bun lang lang du 'char zhing*/ de nas phyi rtags zla ba shar ba ltar dkar lam pa 'byung*/ nang rtags shes pa smig sgyu ltar g.yo ba 'byung ste 'di'i dus phal gyis rang nyid 'chi bar nges pa 'byung zhing*/ de'i 'og tu zhe sdang las gyur pa'i rtog pa sum cu so gsum 'gag go /mched pa thim pas/ phyi rtags nyi ma shar ba ltar dmar lam gyis 'gro/ nang rtags shes pa srin bu me khyer ltar res gsal res mi gsal/ 'di'i dus na/ mdo rnams nas phyi ma'i srid pa'i sa bon 'jog par gsungs te/ sems kyis sngar gyi las gang byas pa de'i shugs kyis rigs drug so so'i snang ba'i bye brag yud tsam 'byung ste/ 'di sa bon btab pa dang 'dra bas/ 'dir mtshams sbyor gal che bar shes so// rgyud las kyang*/ rnal 'byor pa rnams 'pho tshe dpal// khrag 'thung la sogs rnal 'byor ma// me tog sna tshogs lag na thogs// rgyal mtshan ba dan sna tshogs dang*// rol mo'i sgra ni sna tshogs kyis// mkha' spyod gnas su 'khrid par byed// ces 'byung ngo*// sdig can la gshin rje'i pho nya 'byung ste/ de'i 'og tu 'dod chags las gyur pa'i rtog pa bzhi bcu 'gag go /thob pa 'od gsal la thim pas/ phyi rtags sgra gcan mun nag lta bu'i nag 'ub pa'i snang ba 'byung*/ nang rtags mar me ltar gsal sangs pa 'byung*/ de'i dus su gti mug las gyur pa'i rtog pa bdun thim par 'gyur te/ de ltar rtog pa kun gzhi'i steng du bsdus shing*/ nam mkha' ltar gyur nas/ yul drug /dbang po drug /rnam (55)shes drug/ 'byung ba lnga bsdus pa'i skad cig la/ dbu ma'i yar sna'i thig le dkar ba dang*/

mar sna'i dmar ba gnyis srog gi rlung chen po dang*/ rnam par shes pa yud tsam 'dus pa'i tshe/ 'od gsal ba gzhi'i chos sku skad cig 'byung ngo*// de yang ma rig pa'i dbang gis ngo mi shes te/ rnam par shes pa 'phos nas bar do 'byung ngo*// sngar gyi srid pa 'jog lugs ni/ 'dir dmyal bar 'gro ba'i sems can rnams ni/ sngar mi dge ba bcu goms drag pas/ der yang de nyid kyi snang ba 'char te/ rang gi snang ba'i stong gzugs sdud pa snang ba la/ 'char lugs gnyis 'byung ste/ sdig shas che ba/ mnar med la sogs par 'gro ba ni/ gshin rje'i skyes bu la sogs par snang zhing*/ rang gi khrag dang mkhris pa lus la rlung gis gtor nas mig khrag lta bu'am ser por 'gyur/ lus tsha bas gdung bas 'gyur/ srog la chags bzhin 'chi bas/ gnad gcod dag po 'byung ste/ des snang ba yang*/ me 'bar ba dang mtshon cha la sogs pa dang*/ rlung sgra yang log par 'gyur bas/ de nyid dang 'grogs te shi nas rnam shes 'phos pa'i skad cig la cung zad cig bde bar gyur te bltas pas snang ba la nags me dang*/ chu la sogs pa mthong ste/ de 'dod de phyin pa na slar yang las kyi snang ba la sngar gyi gshin rje dag 'ongs nas log par byed pa snang bar bshad do// de bas/ las chung ba ni/ 'chi khar snang ba la dmyal ba'i gnas mtshon gyi nags tshal sngon po dang*/ ri spang gshong dang*/ sems can gcig gis gcig bsad nas sha za ba dang*/ sa phyogs khrag gis gtor ba dag snang nas/ sngar srog gcod goms pa'i dbang gis/ kye ma bdag kyang 'dir 'gro bar bya'o snyam pa 'byung ste/ 'di ni snang ba stobs che ba yin (56)la snga ma ni las sbyin pa de stobs che ba yin no// rgya che bar ni dran pa nyer bzhag tu yod do// yi dwags su 'gro ba yang*/ ser sna shas che ba'i sred pa nyid skye'o// dud 'gror 'gro ba yang dud 'gro de dang de dag la dga' ba chags pa'i sems sam/

yang na ci yang mi dran par rmugs te 'chi ba nyid do// mir skye ba rnams ni mi nyid shin tu chags pa dang bcas pa'i snang ba dang*/ nges pa phal cher 'jug par bshad do// lha ma yin kyang lha dang phyogs mthun kyang cung zad nga rgyal dang bcas par 'gyur ba dang*/ nag phyogs la 'chi bar bshad do// lhar 'gro ba dang bde 'gro 'di rnams kyi srid pa yang 'di ltar bshad de/ gang du skye ba'i gnas na phun sum tshogs pa'i yo byad dang lha dang lha mo rnams khri la 'dug pa mthong zhing*/ der dga' ba'i sems skye ste/ sngar gyi legs par byas pa rnams dran cing 'gyod pa med par 'chi ba dang*/ lha dang bla ma la sogs pa rkyen bzang po 'tshogs shing de nyid kyis srid pa'i sa bon 'jog ste dus kyang phal cher dkar phyogs dang nyi ma gsal ba la 'chi bar bshad do// de ltar snang ba'i rgyu ni sems la dge ba dang*/ mi dge ba sngar byas pa'i bag chags kyi sa bon yod pa de/ lus la rtsa ba dang yan lag gi rlung gnas pa g.yo bas/ du ba dang smig rgyu la sogs pa'i rtags 'byung ba des rkyen byas pas ldang zhing snang ba dang*/ rlung gis stong pa'i sgra rnams tha dad du snang ba nyid do// de nas res shig 'od gsal la zhugs nas/ bar do 'char te/ 'od gsal da lta goms shas med pa rnams de/ dper na srang kha'i mtho dman bzhin/ 'di nub ma thag tu bar do 'byung bar bshad do// gzugs khams su 'gro ba dag ni/ 'dir bsam gtan goms pa'i mthus/ de nyid la gnas pa na/ bsam gtan gyi nyer sdogs (57)las/ gzugs kyi khams der snang ba nyid de 'di rnams la bar do yun ring po med do// gzugs med ni/ gang shi ba de nyid du sngar nam mkha' mtha' yas la sogs pa bzhi po gang goms pa de nyid kyi steng du 'gro bas/ sa bon thams cad pa ma yin pa/ rtog pa gzhan 'gag pa ste bar do gzhan ni med do// rgyud las/ steng nas gzugs med rnams su ste// zhes pa 'byung ba ni/

lus kyi gnas la srid gsum sbyar ba'i dbang du byas kyis/ der 'phos te 'gro ba ma yin par sems so// da ni bar do nyid bshad do// 'dod pa'i khams kyi lha drug dang*// mi dang*/ lha ma yin dang*/ dud 'gro dang*/ yi dwags dang*/ dmyal ba rnams la/ phal cher zhag bdun te/ 'ga' zhig de bas yun ring ba yang bshad de/ bdun phrag bdun la sogs pa 'chad kyang de ni nyung ngo*// bar do de ni/ sngon byung srid dus sha tshugs can// dbang po kun tshang thogs med ldan// las kyi rdzu 'phrul shugs dang ldan// rigs mthun lha mig dag pas mthong*// zhes 'byung ba de nyid de/ mdo las/ dper na skyes bu lus stobs dang ldan pa/ g.yul ngor rta la lhung na myur bar rta de la 'dzegs pa ltar/ skye ba'i 'dun pa la phyogs pas myur du len pa dang srid pa sbyor bar bshad do// de ltar na zhag bdun ci'i phyir 'gor zhe na/ bar do dang po shar ba na/ rmi lam ltar snang ste/ yid kyi lus de ni/ dper na chu nang gi gzugs brnyan lta bu dbang po dang ldan pa/ tshor ba dang*/ 'du shes dang*/ 'du byed dang*/ rnam par shes pas bsdus kyi 'byung ba bzhi ni med do// de'i tshe shi ba'i ro yang mthong la/ shi bar yang shes te rang la yang lus gcig yod par sems pa 'byung zhing*/ kye ma gar skye ba zhig snyam pa na sngar lhar sred (58)pa bzhag pa ni lha pho mo mthong zhing*/ lha gnas kyang mthong der skye ba yang shes pas yid dga' bar 'gyur te/ rgyu des ro yang*/ mig zim bur lta bur lta ba 'dra ba dang*/ mnyen pa dang*/ kha dog gsal ba dang dri zhim par 'gyur ro// 'di rnams phal cher rdzus skyes yin pas zhag bdun pa la skye ba 'grub par gsungs so// lha ma yin kyang phyogs mthun pa'o// de bzhin du lha dang lha ma yin la mngal skyes dang*/ mi rnams ni/ pha ma'i 'du ba'i rkyen mthong nas de la chags pa dang bcas pas mngal du 'jug ste/ 'jug kha der snang ba ni tha dad pa du ma 'byung ste/

las dag pa rnams la ni khang bzang la sogs pa'i snang ba dang*/ 'ga' zhig la 'khrig pa'i 'du shes dang*/ kha cig la skyabs su re nas de'i thu bar 'dzul ba dang*/ dud 'gro la sogs kha cig la/ kha pa dang*/ rlung dang*/ char gyis bdas pa dang*/ de rnams la yibs pa'i gnas btsal ba la sogs pa'i snang ba 'byung ngo*// dmyal ba dang yi dwags phal cher ni/ bar do de yi snang la gshin rje'i skyes bus khrid de/ las so so la gshin rje'i rgyal pos lung bstan nas nyam thag par 'gyur bzhin nying mtshams sbyor bar byed do// 'di rnams kyi'ang phal cher zhag bdun na rdzus te skye'o// de bzhin skye gnas gzhan dag kyang yod mod kyis 'dir ma smos te/ mngal skyes rnams ni mngal du zhugs zin pa nas bar do ma yin mod kyi/ lha phreng thogs rnams ni mngal dang bcas pa'i zhag bdun du'ang gsungs so// bar do de'i gzugs ni/ thams cad mkhyen pas gzigs pa na// gang du skye ba de'i rnam pa can// mtho ris su 'gro ba ni mgo gyen du bstan pa dang*/ ngan 'gro thur du bstan pa kha dog tha dad pa yin no// gzugs khams dang*/ gzugs med dang*/ (59)mnar med ni sngar bshad pa nyid do// 'di rnams ni rgyud dang mdo du ma nas thams cad mkhyen pas gsungs pa la nges pa rnyed de rags pa'i rim pa bkod pa ste/ des na the tshom mi bya'o// lugs du ma yod kyang yi ges 'jigs pas ma bkod do// bar do srid pa'i nying mtshams ni// gang la sred pa de len cing*// srid gsum so sor 'grub byed pas// dang po'i las can skyes bu rnams// de ltar brtson pa'i stobs bskyed nas// snang ba sbyang ba shin tu gces// bar do gnyis pa'i dus 'di ru// rtsal sbyong rmi lam bar do la// snang ba 'gyur zhing zin pa na// srid pa'i bar dor bya ba 'grub// de ltar 'khrul pa'i rjes 'brang nas// nyon mongs rtog pa rang dgar bzhag /bar dor yon tan thob 'dod pa// gti mug 'khrul pas bcing ba lags// de phyir yengs med brtson bskyed la// lus ngag yid gsum dge ba rnams// 'phags pa mchod cing sems can sbyin// rtag tu theg mchog tshul khrims bsrung*// khong khro nga rgyal bcom nas kyang*// brtson pas bsam gtan bsgom bya zhing*// chos rnams rtag tu 'dres par mdzod// de ltar sbyangs shing rang sems la// dbang thob rgyal ba'i zhing sbyangs na// sangs rgyas zhing du 'gro ba dang*// myur du byang chub mchog thob 'gyur// bar do'i dmar khrid cung zad rgyas par byas pa'o//

༈ //'pho ba ni gnyis te/ rten med du 'pho ba/ 'pho ba dngos/ rten can du 'pho ba/ grong du 'jug pa'o// dang po la gsum/ rab 'od gsal la 'pho/ 'bring sgyu lus la 'pho/ tha ma lha sku la 'pho ba'o// dang po gnyis bar dor bshad zin/ lha sku la 'pho ba la rnam grangs gsum ste/ dang po sbyangs te 'pho ba ni/ sngon du rlung 'byongs par byas te/ khyad (60)par du mda' ltar 'phang ba bsgom/ ka hi ka ngag tu brjod pa dang mi brjod pa gnyis las/ dang po sbyang dus ngag tu mi brjod/ rlung tshur 'dzin rtsa na mgrin pa'i oṃ las hūm̐ snying khar chad/ de las a chad nas lte bar shes pa gtad/ phar gtong tsa na a hūm̐ la/ de oṃ la thim/ oṃ yum bzhi'i sa bon a nu ta ra dang bcas pa 'phar ldeg pa lhar bsgom zhing rlung tshangs bug tu sngo phyur phyur bsam mo// las sbyor nus pa'i tshad ni/ lag mthil pus mo lan gsum bskor/ de nas lan cig se gol gtogs// sum cu bdun cu brgya rtsa brgyad// tha ma 'bring dang rab kyi tshad// gzhan thams cad zhal gdams kyi de ka yin pas de ltar bya'o// lus bcos te 'pho ba la/ yi ge la rig pa mi zin na sems 'od ltar bsams la spyi bo'i mdun gyi nam mkha' la/ bla ma'am yi dam

'di rnams lung du byed na thun gcig /de min na sbyang ba la gcig /dngos gzhi la gcig /gzhan la gcig gang gsal gyi thugs khar bsre ba gnad yin/ gzhan la yang btab pas chog go /btsan thabs kyi 'pho ba ni bshad pa tsam yin/ lag len mi bya'o// rten can 'pho ba yang*/ da ltar rlung la dbang thob pa dang*/ snang srid sgyu mar 'byongs na 'byung ste/ ro de gsar pa shi ma thag pa dgos so// gzhan ni gzhung nyid kyi de yin te/ dang po sbyang*/ bar du nyams sad/ tha ma las la sbyar ro// kye ma thun gcig da lta rgyal sras rnams// thugs rje'i rnam thar rgya mtsho yis// sna tshogs thabs kyis gdul bya 'dren// zab mo gnad kyi chos drug 'di// rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i snying po yin// sngar byon grub thob du ma yis// gnad du bsnun cing thugs nyams bzhes// gser zhun lta bu'i gdams pa yin// slad kyi skal ldan sgrub mdzad kun// thog mar byang chub sems bskyed dang*// dbang gis (61)rang rgyud smin byas nas// 'jig rten 'khri ba rtsa bcad de// brtson 'grus ldan pas nyams su longs// thabs kyi rim pa dpag med kyang*// 'di las lhag pa gzhan na med// rtsa ba'i gtum mo/ sgyulus/ rmi lam/ 'od gsal lau// gdams ngag dang po yis// gnas skabs bzhi yi 'khrul pa sel// sku bzhi rang la rtogs par nges// phyag rgya lhan cig skyes sbyor gyis// thabs dang lam gyi zhen pa thongs// da ltar 'bras bu ma thob na// yan lag gnyis kyis nying mtshams sbyor// lus ngag yid gsum gzhan don du// bsngos la smon lam dag pa thob// tshe 'dir yon tan thob par nges// 'di byas dge bas sems can kun// 'khrul pa'i dri ma dag gyur cig /gdams ngag chos drug gi nyams bar do dang 'pho ba/ su blang bya 'di brgyud pa gzhan gyis mi shes par 'dug pas/ rjes 'jug 'ga' zhig la phan snyam nas/ sgom chen rang byung rdo rjes sbyar ba'o/// /dge'o/// /(62)
